methodology.scope: Local native HTTP services, PostgreSQL container VM; no production capacity claim
methodology.generator: Go open-loop, no application retries, 4096 in-flight generator slots, 3s client timeout
methodology.priorities: All requests critical; identical 60/20/20 service proportions
methodology.identity: Synthetic loopback-only trusted header, not production authentication
methodology.reference_semaphore: 12 execution slots, immediate rejection, no reservation; all requests critical
